description: This Java source file defines the `StubGenerator` class, which provides functionality to generate stubbed versions of Java classes, filter out private members, and package them into a JAR file. It is part of the `com.android.mkstubs` package and utilizes ASM library classes for bytecode manipulation.

classes.name: StubGenerator
classes.description: A utility class responsible for generating stub versions of classes, filtering private members, and packaging them into JAR files.

methods.name: generateStubbedJar
methods.description: Creates a stubbed JAR file from a map of class readers, applying specified filters.

methods.name: classNameToEntryPath
methods.description: Converts a fully qualified class name to a JAR entry path.

methods.name: createJar
methods.description: Writes a collection of class byte arrays into a JAR file output stream.

methods.name: visitClassStubber
methods.description: Generates a stubbed bytecode version of a class by applying filtering and stubbing.
